dict.string: Errday uses the camera to scan food barcodes and take meal photos. Meal photos are sent to OpenAI only after you choose Scan Food.
Errday shows the Apple Health data you choose to share, including activity, body, hearing, mobility, nutrition, sleep, vitals, medications and health records, in your private overview.
Errday saves the weight, water, nutrition and completed workouts you track to Apple Health so your records stay consistent.
Errday uses the microphone only while you record a Voice Log.
Errday converts your Voice Log into editable text so the assistant can analyse what you ate.
Errday displays the clinical records you choose to share, such as allergies, conditions, medications, lab results and procedures, only in your private health overview.
